android.desc: The 99 app now offers much more! In addition to rides with 99Pop, 99Plus, 99electric-Pro, 99Taxi, and 99Moto, you can also send packages with 99Entrega, order food with 99Food, and use 99Pay — the digital account that lets you make transfers, pay bills and grow your money. Delivery, transport, and payments — all in one app! Great value, safety, and ride options for every moment of your day! With 99, you can travel by car or motorcycle and even send or receive items. Plus, you can count on our 24-hour assistance, so you never have to worry about unexpected situations. 99 rides are monitored 24 hours a day! We also have a help channel for you inside the app. With 99, safety comes first — along with comfort and savings. Check out our categories: 99Pop: The affordable choice for every occasion! 99Moto: Practical and economical motorcycle rides for your daily trips! 99Plus: For those who need a more spacious and comfortable car. 99electric-Pro: Perfect for anyone looking for a quiet and eco-friendly ride in an electric vehicle. 99Taxi: The traditional taxi at your fingertips, with the safety, comfort, and agility of 99. 99Entrega: Send gifts or make deliveries safely with 99’s reliable transport service! 99 has the ideal car, motorcycle, or taxi for whatever you need. 24/7 Support With 99, passengers have access to 24-hour support for any request related to rides, deliveries, or partner drivers. Safety All 99 partner drivers go through a security verification before joining the platform. To give you more peace of mind, the app also shows each driver’s total rides and time of experience. Clube99 With Clube99, you get discount coupons to use on your rides for less. To access your vouchers, just open the app, click the side menu icon, and tap the gold banner labeled “Clube99.” 99Pay 99Pay is 99’s digital account, available inside the app. With 99Pay, your money grows daily — even on weekends and holidays. Enjoy convenience and security while making transfers, paying bills, recharging your phone, and earning cashback on rides taken with 99. Convenient 99 makes your route easier by offering ride options by car, motorcycle, or taxi with private drivers, as well as an exclusive category for deliveries and package transport. Value, safety, and convenience in every trip — by car, motorcycle, or taxi

quotes.text:
That's not the reason why Uber is getting moderately popular in São Paulo. We have a few great taxi calling apps and here the taxi service is fairly good and reliable (unlike Rio de Janeiro, where taxi service is hell, dishonest, rude and unreliable - there, Uber is a god sent gift).

Here in SP people use it only because of the price (about 30% cheaper than taxi). Uber Black was here for some time and no one never noticed. Only when they came with cheap UberX that people started using.

But taxi lobby fought back hard and Uber is oficially forbidden here until further regulation (unoficially still running though).

Anyway, just to share that here in SP is mostly a price competition. Not much else.

EDIT: Just for curiosity, the two bigger taxi apps in SP
99Taxis: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.taxis99&hl=en
Easy Taxi: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=br.com.easytaxi&hl=en
